info.name: Pure activity milestone API
milestone
Lists all milestones

params.name: size
params.description: Number of returned milestones per request.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for the returned list. 0 or null value is from the start

params.name: order
params.description: The order of the list, must be a value from /milestones/orderings

items.docs: Lists all milestones in the Pure instance. If you need to filter the milestones returned, see the POST version which supports additional filtering.

info.name: Query operation for milestones

items.docs: Lists milestones in the Pure instance that matches the provided query, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an JSON document is posted with the request. The JSON document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options.
